correctness.rationale: The unordered deleted-product chain complex is valid by Prue–Scrimshaw subdivision bounds. Direct reconstruction gives 66/180/117 cells, B1 B2=0 and boundary rank 108 mod 101. Nine explicitly indexed product 2-cycles have a signed 9x9 ambient-chain minor -1. Their primitive rank-nine sublattice equals ker B2 by the rank bound; there are no 3-cells. Exact rational elimination gives rank four for all ten tori of total length <=10. The 9x10 matrix for (3,6)+(5,6) pairs has maximal minors of gcd two, establishing index two; mod-two rank rises to nine with each (3,5) class. Replayed standard-library verifier checks all assertions.

value.rationale: The Tietze graph is a canonical small nonplanar cubic triangle expansion of Petersen. The natural edge-length filtration of embedded motion tori has a sharp integral generating threshold at 11 (the previous threshold spans rank only 4 of 9). A different geometrically defined collection spans rationally yet misses an index-two integral class, which any shortest triangle–pentagon torus repairs. This geometric parity obstruction goes beyond a Betti-number restatement or an arbitrary numerical slice, and may inform analyses of vertex expansions and integral graph-configuration lattices.
